label: Conceiving denial of the bridge / conceiving necessary denial
term: conceiving denial of the bridge / conceiving necessary denial
resolution: H is world-relative StrongBridge; C(¬H), C(□¬H), H, and □H have distinct scopes. The old selfC model makes H and C(¬H) true but C(□¬H) false; the one-step model makes H, □H and C(□¬H) true but C(¬H) false. Converting the necessary-denial conception into a contradiction with □H requires stated accessibility conditions, not a scope substitution.
